main.description: Publish the canonical concept DICTIONARY (:fin.concept/*) — the GAAP-normalization map that lands JP-GAAP (jppfs_cor / jpcrp_cor), US-GAAP (us-gaap:*) and IFRS (ifrs-full:*) taxonomy elements onto one comparable canonical concept. The :synthesized normalization layer (kanjō G5). Honest where standards are NOT comparable (e.g. 経常利益 / ordinary-income is JGAAP-only — carries a note forbidding cross-standard comparison).

dictionaryCid.description: content-address of the published concept dictionary

concept.description: one canonical-concept record (:fin.concept/*) with the source taxonomy elements that normalize into it

jgaap.description: comma-joined EDINET taxonomy elements that map into this concept
